title: Forum and Platform Research: Ayuda Economica Defensive Patterns
scope: Public-source research on discussions and platform surfaces related to ayuda economica ads in Peru, summarized only as defensive detection patterns.
safety_boundary: This report intentionally omits reusable posting templates, optimization tactics, and contact scripts. It records risk patterns for detection and moderation.

Evidence remains sparse through indexed search. Phase 4 needs platform-specific collection tooling and manual review boundaries.

defensive_patterns.description: Financial support language becomes risky when paired with unclear conditions, private contact migration, or implied obligation.
Discretion framing is high-risk when it shifts from privacy protection into secrecy, isolation, or avoidance of trusted support.
Urgency cues around immediate cash needs can compress deliberation and increase susceptibility to unsafe conditions.
Language implying eligibility by age, appearance, relationship status, or discretion can indicate objectifying or coercive selection dynamics.
Moving from a public platform to private messaging reduces moderation visibility and increases safety risk.

recurring_strategies_defensive_summary: Financial offer framing should be reviewed for conditionality and debt-pressure cues.
Private-channel migration should be treated as a risk escalation point.
Discretion language needs context-sensitive review because it may protect privacy or enforce isolation.
Urgency claims should be checked against evidence and paired risk signals.
Eligibility or filtering language can indicate coercive selection or objectification.

frequent_patterns: The strongest defensible patterns at this stage are financial-help conditionality, secrecy/discretion pressure, urgency, and off-platform migration.
Platform evidence is stronger for Locanto as a public classifieds surface than for named forums through indexed search.
Negative search evidence is useful for planning, but it is not source exhaustion.
vulnerability_links: Financial-help conditionality maps to financial_emergency and economic_independence multipliers.
Discretion and private-channel migration map to safety_and_privacy and status_and_respectability multipliers.
Urgency around family or emergency need maps to family_care_obligation and financial_emergency multipliers.
what_worked: The report preserves evidence quality distinctions instead of overstating sparse search results.
Phase 1 and Phase 2 IDs are now connected to concrete defensive detection patterns.
Unsafe operational posting advice was excluded.
what_failed_or_needs_improvement: The named forum corpus was not recovered through indexed search.
No specific public ad records were collected in this phase because collection belongs to Phase 4.
Manual public URL discovery or platform-specific search tooling is needed before claiming exhaustive coverage.
next_phase_strategy: Start Phase 4 with a collector manifest and redaction checks before collecting raw pages.
Document exhaustion criteria explicitly if 10,000 records are not reachable through compliant public collection.
Keep raw content in data/raw and store only redacted processed records in data/processed.
